sourceBytes.rule: Every promoted source file/member must match the exact SHA-256 bound in the typed approval evidence and committed provenance.

rules: This is the explicit state-promoting source gate and may materialize only records with sourceApprovedEligible=true.
The original acquired source bytes are copied unchanged; archive-member originals remain in their original codec.
No trim, denoise, resample, EQ, gain, segmentation, looping edit or transcoding occurs here.
source-approved does not imply derived-master-approved, Unity-integrated, Quest-approved or release-approved.
Any derived edit creates a new file identity and must follow the derived-master listening QA gate.
